findings: AEPD reports receipt of its first notification alleging an AI-agent data breach; this is not its completed investigative finding.
The affected organisation alleges vulnerability searches, successful login, personal-data modification and invoice access.
The regulator explicitly says the notification requires analysis; one notification cannot establish a statistical trend.
Use of a model does not establish that the model provider was compromised or designed the tool for malicious use.
readerJob: Explain the difference between a reported agent-assisted breach and a confirmed investigation, and why existing security permissions still matter. No claim that readers’ personal accounts were affected.
missingEvidence: No completed investigation, named model, affected organisation or personal reader exposure established in these sources. These limit reporting; do not manufacture them.
nextAction: Prepare ordinary safety-incident reporting contract and brief with allegation attribution; check for subsequent AEPD findings before drafting. Then producer review, story-specific art, qualified editorial review and current-date issue admission. Broader Front Paige may link only after independent admission.
